### Evidence anchor for CPRT multiples: trailing P/E regressed on realized next-12m EPS growth (monthly, 2012-2025)
P/E = 27.8 + -0.0 x growth (R² 0.01, n=166; overlapping months, descriptive only).
- growth 4% → fitted P/E 27.8x
- growth 12% → fitted P/E 27.8x
- growth 18% → fitted P/E 27.8x
These fitted multiples come from a 2012-2025 regime of 10-20% EPS growth and zero-to-low rates. They are an upper reference, not a forecast.
